run_doctest_staticmethod: run the doctest module to verify staticmethod behavior on Boost.Python extension classes X and X1
test_staticmethod_count: test that the count static method returns 2 when called on instances or classes X and X1
test_staticmethod_magic: test that the magic static method returns 7654321 when called on instances or classes X and X1
review_doctest_run_function: review the run function that configures sys.argv and executes doctest.testmod for the current module
refactor_doctest_entry_point: refactor the main entry point to customize the doctest output or add additional test reporting
